findingClass: a non-terminal ipo_field_plan row whose stored ranks disagree with the manifest policy for its own manifest_version
whatItAsks: every non-terminal plan row's rank1/rank2/rank3 match the manifest's ranked set for that field, IPO type, at the row's own manifest_version
scope: phase-1 IPOs, MAINBOARD + SME, prod + staging slots; non-terminal (state <> SUPPLIED) rows only — a SUPPLIED row's ranks are frozen audit trail, not a live mis-plan
consumerReason: the plan is reconciled to the manifest on generation, not every cycle — a rank disagreement is a per-run structural fact, read by identity (plan row) each run
